final_answer.key_evidence_summary: emailservice pod emailservice-5795bc6dc5-tt6tf is 0/1 Running with Restart Count 0; kubelet events repeat 'Readiness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.1.56:8081" within 1s: context deadline exceeded' (x10). GetAppYAML shows readinessProbe.grpc.port=8081 while the container only exposes containerPort 8080, env PORT=8080, and livenessProbe correctly uses 8080 (so the container is never killed -> RESTARTS 0 everywhere). Source email_server.py binds only '[::]:'+os.environ.get('PORT','8080') and logs 'listening on port: 8080', so nothing listens on 8081. Consequence: the emailservice Service endpoints list is empty while every other service has endpoints, so the pod never becomes Ready and is removed from the Service, breaking upstream callers (checkoutservice). Break point = readiness probe port (8081) mismatching the application's real listening port (8080).
